name: Fan cards
description: A tight stack of cards that fans open along a shallow arc when you reach for it, with a band of light crossing the title.

props.name: cards
props.description: Three to five cards, each filling the card size. The last one is on top of the stack.

props.name: title
props.description: A heading under the stack. A band of water-blue light passes across it once each time the fan opens.

props.name: spread
props.description: Distance in pixels between neighbouring cards when open. It shrinks to fit a narrow container.

props.name: rotation
props.description: Degrees each card turns from its neighbour when open.

props.name: cardWidth
props.description: Width of a card, in pixels.

props.name: cardHeight
props.description: Height of a card, in pixels.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the stack, which is focusable. Defaults to the title when it is a string. Focus or Enter opens it; on touch a tap toggles it.
